text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy achieved great results in the Twinkle Series, leaving an unforgettable bite mark on the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had made it through those crucial 'first three years.'
However—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The checkup's finally over, da noda...
I really hate the way hospitals smell, da nodaaaa~~!
choice_data_list: Glad it was only a minor injury.
Thank goodness it was just a minor injury.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Repeated racing had caused a slight concern in her legs.
However, we were told there should be no problem as long as
she takes it easy and rests her legs for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Minion~~! It's so hard to walk in this~! I can't even go play pranks nowww...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey, it doesn't even hurt, so why do I have to take a break from training?
choice_data_list: So that you can keep on running forever.
So you can keep running for a long, long time

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrrgh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Stingy---!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Although she only needed crutches for a few days,
she had to take good care of her leg in daily life
for a while afterward.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai!
Is there anything troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I heard you're taking a break.
Let me know if there's anything you need.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You guys... are kinda nice.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, everyone has been watching
how hard you've worked, Windy-san♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh♪
Still, I'm so glad it wasn't anything serious~.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That's right, nanoda... It's really no big deal, but that Trainer of mine keeps telling me to rest and rest...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Eeeek! That guy is such a worrywart...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hmm...?
Come to think of it, feels like this has happened before...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "He told me she might get shin splints, so we should keep her runs easy for a while..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so that happened.
See, you really are a great Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nu?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure...
it's because I held back properly back then.
That's how I was able to keep running through these three years.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's true... Thanks to that, you didn't panic and kept going.
Fufu... I'm sure it's the exact same right now.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nu, nuuu...
How could... how could that guy...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, after all, she is the evil chief of staff
personally chosen by Windy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm always proper about things like that! Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Why are you acting so high and mighty, Senpai?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...We really gotta thank her.
Windy-senpai, do you usually make sure
to say thanks properly?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wha...! It's not like I need a thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Greetings and saying thank you are super important, you know?
Even Dr. Veggie from Carrotman said so!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Gnnnhhh!
That's, that's just...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
She's Windy-chan's subordinate, so...
I-I-I don't need it... at all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...Still... maybe just a little bit,
as a subordinate, I could... 'appreciate' you."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Geez, you're really not honest with yourself.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: If you're going to tell them, I think this turning point is your best chance, though.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right? If you miss your chance now,
won't it just get harder to say later?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after visiting the hospital,
Shinko Windy suddenly called me over...
choice_data_list: (What could it be, in a place like this?)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Minion... you actually made it on time, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-W-What's the matter, you ask...?
Well, the thing is...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: B-Because it's pretty, that's why!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The flowers are...
telling me to look at them a lot...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look out over the flower field. It certainly is beautiful.
The breeze feels nice too.
Is this what she wanted to show me...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-When I asked my mom, she said 'flowers' would be nice...
Especially roses...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway, we're going for a little walk!
We'll talk after that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking leisurely along the promenade,
I arrived at an elevated spot with a wonderful view.
I ended up walking a bit longer than planned, though...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mm! I'm completely fine!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The doctor said it's about time I started walking
and doing light jogging anyway.
If anything, walking is totally fine.
choice_data_list: In that case, that's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Geez, you're such a worrywart...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's not it, listen...
Umm... Uhhh... I am doing it properly!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're always... thinking so hard
about so many things... for Windy-chan's sake...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"And... that's why...
These past three years... having you... by my side..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Uuuu... Like I said...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nodding repeatedly,
she gently took the bouquet
while still surprised by the sudden gesture.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: E-Eep! It's not a prank, I tell you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Today is different, I say... It's just a regular flower, I say...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's not out of nowhere...
Because, because, you...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: She ran alongside me all this time...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan alone... probably
couldn't have made it this far."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere along the way, I might've ruined things,
or just broken down... nanoda.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So... that's why it's a flower!
I gotta show appreciation for my minion once in a while!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Thank you, nanoda...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her tiny voice, pushed to its very limit, was swallowed up by the blue sky.
Even so, it reached my ears loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
These three years with this high-maintenance girl were tough.
Even so, until the day her ambitions truly come to pass,
I want to stay by her side and keep supporting her...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, that was what they strongly thought—
